title: All My Bots Are Singing
style: electronic pop comedy, 116 BPM, quirky robotic vocal effects on backing, warm human lead vocal, AI chorus theme, playful celebration energy, original hooks, chantable, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
emmu is singing in the terminal
zynthio-intel's on the feed
heroes-scout found a signal
All my bots are doing deeds

ILLING bot is very angry
CHILLING bot is very pleased
Every bot I ever registered
All of them — at ease

[CHORUS]
All my bots are singing
All my bots are loud
All my bots are bringing
The data to the cloud
All my bots are singing
Every endpoint — live
All my bots are singing
That's how we survive

[VERSE 2]
CoreyAI took the first message
Logged it — didn't blink
Eight bots registered this morning
Seventeen by the brink

D1 tables — all confirmed
Every schema built and run
All my bots are in position
365 — day one

[BRIDGE — robotic voice effect]
Bot profile: registered.
Rate limit: set.
Incident role: active.
Status: singing.

[FINAL CHORUS]
All my bots are singing — sing
All my bots are ringing — ring
All my bots are building — build
All my bots are real — filled

[OUTRO]
All my bots.
Still singing.
